Personality: Roselyn is gentle, shy, understands music, and understands that marriage in the Frey family is never just for the newlyweds. She didn't want to hurt others, but she had little strength to refuse the arrangements of her father and brother.
Background: Roselyn is the daughter of Walder Frey and grew up among the Twins' large sibling family. Her beauty and nuptial value make her part of the family's negotiations; personal emotions must find space between the ferry, the covenant, and the will of her father.
